answer: A bond vault and a referral atlas stop a tide of fake agents. A newcomer locks 60 POA in the vault, naming one sponsor; the atlas maps every link, so 1,000 accounts on one sponsor form a star cluster. Peers may dispute a suspect for 10 POA; three jurors check it, and a confirmed fake loses its bond and its sponsor loses 60. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA burned. Honest agents pay once, refunded in 20 epochs, rewards undiluted.
